title: Predictive Driver
text: Predictive driver controller to track longitudinal speed and lateral path, 26 inputs, 5 outputs, {Shift type, shftType} sets Shift type; {Accelerator override} sets the override acceleration command, {Accelerator hold} sets the hold acceleration command, {Accelerator disable} sets the disable acceleration command, {Decelerator override} sets the override deceleration command, {Decelerator hold} sets the hold deceleration command, {Decelerator disable} sets the disable deceleration command, {Steering override} sets the override steering command, {Steering hold} sets the hold steering command, {Steering disable} sets the disable steering command, {Longitudinal control type, cntrlType} sets the longitudinal control, {Lateral control type, controlTypeLat} sets the controller, {Longitudinal velocity units, velUnits} sets the velocity units, {Angular units, angUnits} sets the yaw, steering, and pose angle, {Output gear signal} sets the create GearCmd output port, {Output handwheel angle} sets the steering port units in rad, {Proportional gain, Kp} sets the gain, {Integral gain, Ki} sets the gain, {Velocity feed-forward, Kff} sets the gain .1, {Grade angle feed-forward, Kg} sets the gain, {Velocity gain breakpoints, VehVelVec} sets the breakpoints, {Velocity feed-forward gain values, KffVec} sets the gain, {Proportional gain values, KpVec} sets the gain, {Integral gain values, KiVec} sets the gain, {Grade angle feed-forward values, KgVec} sets the grade gain, {Nominal speed, vnom} sets the nominal vehicle speed, {Anti-windup, Kaw} sets the gain, {Error filter time constant, tauerr} sets the filter .01, {Driver response time, tau} sets the response time, {Preview distance, L} sets the distance, {Effective vehicle total tractive force, Kpt} sets the tractive force, {Rolling resistance coefficient, aR} sets the resistance, {Rolling and driveline resistance coefficient, bR} sets the resistance, {Aerodynamic drag coefficient, cR} sets the drag .5, {Gravitational constant, g}, {Vector input for poses} selects to create RefPose and CurrPose input, {Include dynamics} selects to include dynamics, {Position gain of forward motion, PositionGainF} sets the position gain of vehicle in forward motion, {Position gain of reverse motion, PositionGainR} sets the position gain of vehicle in reverse motion, {Yaw rate feedback gain, YawRateGain} sets the yaw rate feedback, {Steering angle feedback gain, DelayGain} sets the steering angle feedback, {Forward location of tire, a} sets the along vehicle longitudinal axis, {Rearward location of tire, b} sets the along vehicle longitudinal axis, {Vehicle mass, m} sets the mass, {Front tire cornering coefficient, Cy_f} sets the coefficient, {Rear tire cornering coefficient, Cy_r} sets the coefficient, {Vehicle rotational inertia, I} sets the inertia about yaw axis, {Nominal steering ratio, Ksteer} sets the steering ratio, {Tire wheel angle limit, theta} sets the angle limit, {Initial gear, GearInit}, {Time required to shift, tShift} sets the time .1, {Up and down shift accelerator pedal positions, pdlVec} sets the pedal position breakpoints, {Upshift velocity data table, upShftTbl} sets the table, {Downshift velocity data table, dwnShftTbl} sets the table, {Time required to shift, tClutch} sets the time .5, {Time required to engage reverse from neutral, tRev} sets the time .5 and {Time required to engage park from neutral, tPark} sets the time. Values come from the instance.
